content.scenario: Rahul purchased a smartphone from a retail store, which exploded due to a manufacturing defect, causing him physical harm. He filed a complaint before the District Commission seeking damages for the harm suffered.
content.outcome: The District Commission awarded Rahul damages for the physical harm caused by the defective product, as well as compensation for the mental agony and distress suffered.
